briefs_flat_note: The validator reads briefs from tracks[].briefs; exactly 15 total. This note exists for humans: do not add a separate briefs array.
no_false_demo: Briefs are plans, not products. Only quests with status playable appear with Play links on the site; everything else is explicitly labelled. (doc 03 §13)
note: Blueprint §13 specified the 15 across the OLD track system (Little Explorers / Play Garden / School Starters / Adventure Club / Quest Makers / Young Explorers). The 2026-10-10 locked decision rebuilt kids as 4 tracks from age 5, so the 15 are re-distributed 4/4/4/3 across School Starters, Adventure Club, Quest Makers, Young Explorers, preserving §13's intent: coverage across age bands, all 4 reusable templates exercised, minimum 3 narrated modules per character.

retired.note: Quests K01–K03 belonged to the 2–3 track, deleted in the 2026-10-10 kids restructure (entry at age 5). They are retired, not backlogged.
